issue.title: Unable to Use Wildcard When Targeting Data Streams with UpdateByQuery

repository.name: go-elasticsearch
repository.description: The official Go client for Elasticsearch

issue.body:
When using `UpdateByQuery`, I am unable to target a data stream using a wildcard. 

For example:

```
 indexPatterns := []string{'mydatastreamprefix-*'}
 res, err := client.UpdateByQuery(
	        indexPatterns,
		client.UpdateByQuery.WithContext(ctx),
		client.UpdateByQuery.WithPretty(),
		client.UpdateByQuery.WithConflicts("proceed"),
		client.UpdateByQuery.WithBody(read),
		client.UpdateByQuery.WithRefresh(true),
		client.UpdateByQuery.WithWaitForCompletion(true),
 )
```

However, this works fine if I target an _index_ with a wildcard. Is this functionality missing from the client?

Thanks!
Wes

body: Hi, I was wondering if there has been any movement on this issue? This prevents us from fully leveraging data streams. Thanks!
Hi, I just wanted to check in again. Is there any way we could help work towards a solution for this issue?

It appears this is simply due to the fact that [`UpdateByQueryRequest`](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/3506d5e7382aa0a393bfcb202cf776a5c25dfcec/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/reindex/UpdateByQueryRequest.java#L29) doesn't override `includeDataStreams` and inherits the [default implementation](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/3506d5e7382aa0a393bfcb202cf776a5c25dfcec/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/IndicesRequest.java#L37-L39) from `IndicesRequest` (i.e. `return false`).  
[`DeleteByQueryRequest`](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/3506d5e7382aa0a393bfcb202cf776a5c25dfcec/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/reindex/DeleteByQueryRequest.java) seems to have the same issue.

Assuming we want to support datastreams here (and I haven't done anything thinking about what the implications might be) then the change itself should be simple.
